Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Thank you for your offer and for outlining the proposed annual volume, contract term and lead time. We are ready to make a firm long-term volume commitment, provided the full volume is secured, and are open to discussing a longer contract term and mutually workable lead times on that basis.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Your on-time delivery over the last 12 months was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 27.69, volume_per_year 23400, contract_months 24, lead_time_days 42). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We acknowledge your volume commitment of 23,400 units over a 24-month term. A reduction in lead time to 42 days is incompatible with our current capacity utilization unless a significant premium is applied. 

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Our primary offer is a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, by maintaining the lead time at 54 days, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit: a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Thank you for reviewing the supporting data and clarifying your capacity constraints and final offer. We are ready to commit firmly for the long term and work with the longer lead time; as a final request before closing, please confirm that the full annual volume will be secured throughout the contract term.

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 24 months.

We accept your alternative as you proposed it; it is attached as a term sheet for your confirmation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept the terms as outlined in your term sheet. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. We confirm that the annual volume of 23,400 units is secured for the 24-month contract duration.

Which volume can you commit to? We will now proceed with our standard commercial procedure. This Angebot stays valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
